User.title: User
User.description: Private account identity, authorization role, and contact credentials for a registered user.

id.description: Unique identifier corresponding to Firebase Authentication UID.

role.description: User access role; only admin can view or moderate other accounts.

isActive.description: Flag indicating whether account is active or suspended.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp representing account creation time.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: Discoverable matrimonial and relationship profile displaying vetted background, values, and attributes.

id.description: Unique profile identifier, matching or linked to userId.

userId.description: ID of the user who owns this profile.

location.description: City, state or region of residence.

education.description: Highest educational qualification and alma mater.

bio.description: Personal biography and personal background statement.

relationshipGoal.description: Intent for marriage or partnership horizon.

isVisible.description: Discovery visibility toggle controlled by profile owner.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp representing profile creation time.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp representing latest profile update time.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Mutual or concierge-introduced matchmaking pair connecting two verified users with active countdown.

id.description: Unique identifier for the match pair.

user1Id.description: User ID of the first match participant.

user2Id.description: User ID of the second match participant.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the match connection.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when the active conversation window expires.

endedAt.description: Optional timestamp when a match concluded or was closed.

extendedCount.description: Number of times this match window was extended.

/users/{userId}.description: Private account identity, credentials, and PII isolated strictly to the account owner and platform admins.

/profiles/{profileId}.description: Discoverable matchmaking profiles for verified members with privacy visibility controls.

/matches/{matchId}.description: Active or historical matchmaking records connecting two authenticated users with strict participant-only access.

/matches/{matchId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time private chat messages scoped to an active match pair.
